title: 💰 Master Motorcycle Fines & Demerit Points Matrix
summary:
• Equipment & Minor Infractions (NT$300–$1,000):
  - Helmet unfastened / not worn: NT$500 fine on spot.
  - Handheld mobile phone use while riding: NT$1,000 flat fine.
  - Cargo overloading / dimension violations (exceeding shoulder height or handlebar width): NT$300 to NT$600.
• Turns, Lanes & Pedestrian Priority (NT$600–$6,000):
  - Occupying oncoming lane to turn left before intersection center: NT$600 to NT$1,800.
  - Failure to yield to pedestrians on crosswalk: NT$1,200 to NT$6,000 + 3 demerit points.
  - Running a red light (caught on spot): NT$1,800 to NT$5,400 + 3 demerit points.
• High-Risk Violations & Demerit Accumulations:
  - Speeding > 40 km/h over limit: NT$6,000 to NT$36,000 + 6-month vehicle plate suspension.
  - Dangerous tailgating / aggressive driving: NT$6,000 to NT$36,000 + safety training.
  - Railway crossing violations: NT$15,000 to NT$90,000 + 3 demerit points (accident = license revoked for life).

title: 🍷 Alcohol BAC Limits, DUI Escalations, Impoundment & Interlocks
summary:
• Statutory Thresholds:
  - Administrative Fine Threshold: Breath alcohol ≥ 0.15 mg/L (or blood alcohol ≥ 0.03%). Fine of NT$15,000–$90,000 for motorcycles + driver license suspension for 1–2 years.
  - Criminal Prosecution Threshold: Breath alcohol ≥ 0.25 mg/L (or blood alcohol ≥ 0.05%) under Public Safety Offenses (Criminal Code 185-3).
• Multi-Tier Escalations & Zero-Tolerance Enforcement:
  - Repeat Offense (within 10 years): 2nd offense = previous fine + NT$90,000 + vehicle plate suspension for 2 years; 3rd offense = previous fine + NT$90,000 + vehicle confiscated.
  - Breathalyzer Refusal: Instant NT$180,000 fine + driver license revocation + vehicle impoundment + mandatory road safety course.
  - Adult Passengers (Aged 18+): Fined NT$6,000 to NT$15,000 for knowingly riding with a drunk driver.
  - Vehicle Owner Liability: Same monetary fine as the driver + license plates suspended for 2 years.
  - Ignition Interlock Device: Mandatory for 1 year upon license reapplication; riding an unequipped vehicle incurs a fine of NT$60,000–$120,000.

title: 📦 Motorcycle Dimensions, Cargo Limits & Passenger Seating
summary:
• Cargo Weight Limitations:
  - Heavy Motorcycles (Standard & Large): Cargo must not exceed 80 kg.
  - Light Motorcycles: Cargo must not exceed 50 kg.
• Physical Cargo Dimensions:
  - Height: Must NOT exceed the driver's shoulders.
  - Width: Must NOT extend beyond the outer edges of the handlebars.
  - Length/Rear Extension: Must NOT extend more than 0.5 meters (50 cm) beyond the rear axle/seat.
  - Front Extension: Must NOT extend beyond the front axle/front wheel.
• Passenger Regulations:
  - Heavy motorcycle: May carry 1 passenger on the designated rear seat; passengers must sit facing forward straddling the seat.
  - Small light motorcycle: Must NOT carry any passengers.
  - Sidecars: Cargo weight must not exceed 150 kg.
• Small & Light Motorcycle Curb Weight:
  - Small light motorcycles (including battery) must not exceed 70 kg curb weight.
  - Maximum overall height of any motorcycle from the ground must not exceed 2.5 meters.

title: ⚡ Speeds, Following Distances, Tire Maintenance & Mountain Riding
summary:
• Roadway Speed Limits:
  - Unmarked roads (no centerline or lane dividing lines): Maximum 40 km/h.
  - Marked single-lane or multi-lane general roads: Maximum 50 km/h (unless posted otherwise).
  - Railway level crossings, school zones, and construction zones: Maximum 15 km/h.
• Following Distance & Reaction Time:
  - Maintain a minimum 2-second following buffer in dry conditions (3–4 seconds in wet/foggy weather).
  - Lateral clearance when overtaking/passing: At least 0.5 meters side buffer.
• Tire Safety & Braking Control:
  - Tire Age Standard: Recommended max service life is 6 years from manufacturing date.
  - Tire Tread Depth: Must not be worn below 0.8 mm (check tread wear indicator bar TWI).
  - Brake Lever Free Play: Must have 1 to 2 cm of free travel before engaging.
  - Mountain Riding: Right hand modulates throttle smoothly; lean with the bike; downhill requires engine braking (low gear) rather than continuous brake drag to prevent brake fade.

title: 🛑 Right-of-Way Hierarchy, 2-Stage Hook Turns & Overtaking
summary:
• Uncontrolled Intersection Priority Hierarchy:
  1. Priority Hierarchy by Road Type: Branch roads MUST yield to Main roads (支道讓幹道).
  2. Priority by Vehicle Movement: Left-turning vehicles MUST yield to straight-going vehicles (轉彎車讓直行車).
  3. Same Road Width / Movement: Vehicle approaching from the LEFT yields to vehicle from the RIGHT (左方車讓右方車).
• Two-Stage Left Turn (Hook Turn 兩段式左轉):
  - Mandatory when: (1) Innermost lane is marked with 'No Motorcycles' (禁行機車), (2) Two-stage left turn regulatory sign is posted, or (3) Driving on a road with 3 or more fast lanes.
  - Hook Turn Procedure: Ride straight on the green light into the designated waiting box on the far right, turn 90° to face the cross-street, and proceed when the cross-street signal turns green.
• Roundabout & Grade Separation:
  - Vehicles outside a roundabout MUST yield to vehicles already circling inside the roundabout.
  - Steep slope passing: Downhill vehicle yields to uphill vehicle; if downhill is already midway, uphill yields.

title: 🅿️ Parking Rules, Curb Colors & Distance Clearances
summary:
• Curb Markings & Meaning:
  - Solid Red Curb Line: Both temporary stopping and parking are strictly PROHIBITED 24 hours a day.
  - Solid Yellow Curb Line: Parking PROHIBITED from 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM daily. Temporary stopping (≤ 3 minutes, driver in seat, engine ready) is permitted.
  - Yellow Grid Lines (Diagonal Mesh): Strictly prohibited from stopping inside intersection or gate area.
• Distance Clearances from Critical Infrastructure:
  - Fire Hydrants & Fire Station Exits: No stopping or parking within 5 METERS.
  - Intersections, Bus Stops & Railway Crossings: No stopping or parking within 10 METERS.
  - Direct Citation for Illegal Parking: Consecutive citations may be issued every 2 hours if vehicle remains unmoved.

title: 🛑 Visual Signs, Road Markings & Signal Compliance
summary:

  - White Diamond Marking (菱形標線): Painted on road surface ~30m before pedestrian crosswalks to alert riders to slow down.
  - Double Solid Yellow Line (雙黃實線): Directional dividing line; strictly prohibits crossing, overtaking, or U-turns.
  - Yellow Grid Lines: Keep intersection clear; temporary stopping is prohibited.
  - White Solid Road Edge Line: Width is 15 cm; separates roadway from road shoulder.
• Critical Prohibitory & Regulatory Signs:
  - Red Circle with Truck + Trailer: No large trucks or articulated vehicles allowed.
  - Red Circle with Motorcycle Silhouette: Motorcycles prohibited from entering.
  - Blue Circle with White Motorcycle: Motorcycle designated lane.
  - Red Inverted Triangle / Octagon: Yield (讓) / Stop (停) before entering intersection.

title: 🩺 Emergency Trauma First Aid, CPR Protocol & Accident Scenes
summary:
• Emergency CPR Procedure (Call → Call → C → A → B → D):
  - 1. Call patient (check consciousness) → 2. Call 119 & request AED → 3. Compressions (C) → 4. Airway (A) → 5. Breathing (B) → 6. Defibrillation (D).
• CPR Compressions Standards (Adult):
  - Ratio: 30 chest compressions to 2 rescue breaths (30:2).
  - Rate: 100 to 120 compressions per minute.
  - Depth: At least 5 cm, not exceeding 6 cm.
  - Breathing assessment: Check for normal breathing for at least 5 seconds, max 10 seconds.
• Trauma Triage Protocols:
  - Unconscious victim with normal breathing: Place in Recovery Position (lateral recumbent) to keep airway open.
  - Fracture with unconsciousness: Treat unconsciousness / airway FIRST, splint fractures SECOND ('Life over Limb').
  - Choking / Foreign Body Airway Obstruction: Perform Heimlich maneuver (abdominal thrusts) between navel and xiphoid process.
  - Shock: Face appears pale with cool clammy skin; keep victim warm with a blanket.
  - Bleeding: Arterial bleeding spurts bright red blood continuously; apply direct pressure.

tricky_bookmarks.prompt: Which is the correct position for external chest compressions in CPR?
tricky_bookmarks.correct_answer: (3) the lower half of the sternum in the center of the chest between the nipples
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: Chest compressions are performed on the lower half of the sternum in the center of the chest.

tricky_bookmarks.prompt: When performing the Heimlich maneuver, where should the hands be clenched into a fist and placed?
tricky_bookmarks.correct_answer: (3) slightly above the navel and well below the xiphoid process
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: Heimlich fist placement is slightly above the navel and well below the xiphoid process.

tricky_bookmarks.prompt: When a victim is in shock during a traffic accident, their facial color appears:
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: Trauma shock produces a pale face and cold extremities due to peripheral vasoconstriction.

title: 📋 Licensing Categories, Reapplication Bans, Compulsory Insurance & Admin Laws
summary:
• Driver Licensing Qualifications:
  - Minimum Age: 18 years old for Light Motorcycle and Standard Heavy Motorcycle; 20 years old for Large Heavy Motorcycle (plus holding standard heavy license for 1 year).
  - Vision Standards: Corrected vision in each eye ≥ 0.6, both eyes together ≥ 0.8; field of vision in both eyes ≥ 150 degrees.
• Retake Waiting Periods & Statutory Bans:
  - Failed written or road test: Must wait at least 7 DAYS before retaking.
  - Cheating on test / Dishonest registration: License canceled + 5-YEAR BAN on retaking test.
  - Lending driver's license to another person: 3-MONTH driver license suspension.
• Compulsory Automobile Liability Insurance (強制險):
  - Certificate Validity: Must have at least 30 DAYS of remaining validity when transferring ownership or applying for inspection.
  - Benefit Items: Covers medical payments, disability, and death benefits (injuries to body/life); does NOT cover vehicle property damage.
